channel.title: Pomorix Blog
channel.description: Guides to the Pomodoro Technique, studying, focus and habits from the team behind Pomorix.

item.title: The Pomodoro Technique: A Complete Guide to the Tomato Timer Method
item.description: What the Pomodoro Technique is, how the 25/5 rhythm works, why it helps you focus, common mistakes and how to adapt it for study and deep work.

item.title: How to Use a Pomodoro Timer: A Step-by-Step Guide for Beginners
item.description: A practical walkthrough of your first day with a Pomodoro timer: setting it up, planning tasks, running sessions, taking breaks and reviewing your focus.

item.title: 25/5, 50/10 or 90 Minutes? How to Choose Your Pomodoro Length
item.description: Compare the most popular Pomodoro intervals (25/5, 50/10, 52/17 and 90-minute blocks) and find the focus and break length that suits your work.

item.title: What to Do on a Pomodoro Break: 25 Ideas That Actually Recharge You
item.description: The best things to do in a 5-minute or 30-minute Pomodoro break, what to avoid, and how to make sure your break ends on time.

item.title: How Many Pomodoros a Day Is Realistic? A Guide to Setting a Daily Focus Goal
item.description: How many Pomodoro sessions you can really do in a day as a student or professional, how to set a daily focus goal, and how to grow it without burning out.

item.title: Flowtime vs Pomodoro: Which Focus Method Fits the Way You Work?
item.description: How the Flowtime Technique (Flowmodoro) differs from the Pomodoro Technique, the pros and cons of each, and how to combine them for study and deep work.

item.title: How to Choose the Best Pomodoro Timer App for Android: A 12-Point Checklist
item.description: What separates a great Pomodoro or study timer app from a distracting one: 12 things to check before you install, from reliable alerts to privacy and stats.

item.title: How to Study with the Pomodoro Technique: A Study Plan That Actually Works
item.description: Use the Pomodoro Technique to study smarter: plan revision in sessions, combine it with active recall and spaced repetition, and follow a sample study day.

item.title: How Long Should You Study Without a Break? A Practical Guide to Study Breaks
item.description: How long you can study before your focus fades, how often to take breaks, how long they should be, and the signs you need one right now.

item.title: How to Make an Exam Study Schedule You'll Actually Follow
item.description: A step-by-step way to build an exam revision timetable: count your study time, split topics into sessions, space your revision and adjust every week.

item.title: How to Stay Focused While Studying: 15 Practical Tips That Work
item.description: 15 practical, research-backed ways to concentrate while studying: set up your space, beat phone distractions, use focus sessions and keep your energy up.

item.title: Brown Noise, Rain or Lo-fi? How to Choose Focus Sounds for Studying
item.description: Does background noise help you study? Compare brown, pink and white noise, rain, café sounds and lo-fi, and learn how to pick the right sound for each task.

item.title: How to Track Your Study Hours (and Why It Makes You Study More)
item.description: Why tracking focused study time works, what to measure, how to review it weekly, and the easiest ways to log study hours without extra effort.

item.title: How to Stop Procrastinating: 12 Tactics That Start With Just 25 Minutes
item.description: Why you procrastinate (it's not laziness), and 12 tactics to start the tasks you've been avoiding, from tiny first steps to timed focus sessions.

item.title: How to Improve Your Focus and Concentration: A Practical, Science-Backed Guide
item.description: Why focus feels harder than ever, and practical ways to rebuild your concentration: single-tasking, focus sessions, attention training, sleep and tracking.

item.title: How to Do Deep Work: Plan, Protect and Track Your Deep Work Sessions
item.description: A practical guide to deep work: what it is, how long sessions should be, how to schedule and protect them, and how to measure your deep work over time.

item.title: How to Stop Checking Your Phone While Studying or Working
item.description: Why you keep picking up your phone, and 10 practical ways to stop: distance, Do Not Disturb, timed sessions, notification clean-up and better breaks.

item.title: Pomodoro Technique for ADHD: How to Make Timers Work for Your Brain
item.description: Practical ways to adapt the Pomodoro Technique for ADHD: shorter sessions, visible time, handling hyperfocus, body doubling, transitions and rewards.

item.title: The Pomodoro Technique for Programmers: Focus Without Losing Your Flow
item.description: How developers can use the Pomodoro Technique without breaking flow: longer sessions, Flow mode, handling builds and code reviews, and protecting focus.

item.title: How to Build a Daily Focus Habit with Goals and Streaks
item.description: Turn focused study or work into a daily habit: start tiny, anchor it to your routine, set a realistic goal, use streaks wisely and recover from missed days.
